comparison.objective: Reattach a detached wrist camera to the robot.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate and align a camera at the wrist interface, engage its attachment, and secure it in the correct pose.
comparison.success_condition: Camera mechanically attached and correctly located/oriented, with unsafe or incomplete attachment rejected.
comparison.reason: Module reattachment tests mating-interface alignment and retention. The candidate adjusts an installed mechanism and measures carriage deceleration; tool access alone is not enough to make them duplicates.
